dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Multiple irregular 'O' and 'C' shaped structures are visible with high-contrast, light-colored perimeters against a dark field. The most prominent structures include a distinct 'O' shape on the lower-right lateral margin and a larger, more complex annulus in the central-upper region. The geometry is characterized by jagged, non-uniform edges where light-intensity pixels transition sharply to the dark interior.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Low density of small, localized high-intensity pixel clusters. These are primarily situated within the light-colored perimeter lines of the macro-annuli and scattered as isolated speckles in the upper-left dorsal quadrant.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the three most defined annuli on the right lateral side form a right-leaning triangular spatial relationship, which connects to a fourth prominent centroid in the upper-central region to form an irregular, elongated quadrilateral.

other_distinctive_markers: A branching, filigree-like network of high-contrast light pixels connects several macro-annuli across the central dorsal surface, creating a distinct marbled texture.
